claim: A moving or rotating sector never leaves its parent sector, and nothing else (a lighting cut, a pocket, masonry round it) may cut that parent. Leaves hang alone in an open bay of the room, about 64 thick.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-23: 'moving or rotating sector can never leave it's parent sector this is the rule of build engine'.
Precedent for a lone leaf in its bay: E2M5 s569/s570 (617).
use: Check the sweep stays in the host; keep light stages from cutting hosts.
